notes.title: 🌟 Kickstarter Launch Announcement: Join Our Epic Journey! 🚀 UPDATE #02
notes.notes:
[center][b]Hello, incredible adventurers,[/b] 🌟[/center]

We have some [i]exciting[/i] news to share with you! After months of dedication and your unwavering support, we’re thrilled to announce the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tailsoffate/tails-of-fate?ref=3rxkxd]launch of our Kickstarter campaign[/url] for [b]Tails of Fate[/b]! 🚀

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tailsoffate/tails-of-fate?ref=3rxkxd][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43611450/9bb388cfbe6bf9cdc5c298100faf0ce96f473178.png[/img][/url]

[h2][center][b]🌟 Kickstarter Campaign is Now [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tailsoffate/tails-of-fate?ref=3rxkxd]Live[/url]! 🌟[/b][/center] [/h2]

The journey begins now! Our crowdfunding [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tailsoffate/tails-of-fate?ref=3rxkxd]campaign for [b]Tails of Fate[/b][/url] is live, and we want you to be a part of it. By backing our project, you’ll receive exclusive rewards and have a chance to leave your mark on the game! 🌟

We’re also debuting a brand [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=kmiYBo_6S2w]new reveal trailer[/url] for the game to celebrate the Kickstarter launch—check it out and let us know what you think! 🎥✨

Don’t miss out on early bird discounts for the game. There are fantastic rewards available, including our Ultimate Collector’s Edition, which comes with an exclusive plushie 🧸, a figurine 🗿, and exclusive digital content (a VIP tavern room)! 🏰

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43611450/b4d911f6c6ca045430898d8bce0e4bc557f10273.png[/img]

For any questions or to stay updated, join our Discord and follow us on social media. 📢👥

Until our next update, [center][i]Chase The Bunny Studios 🐰🎮[/i][/center]

notes.title: Exciting News from Tails of Fate! 🎮✨ UPDATE #01
notes.notes:
[h1]Hey there, amazing Tails of Fate community![/h1]

We have some HUGE news that we're excited to share with you today! 🌟

After months of hard work, dedication, and your incredible support, we've got three thrilling updates for you:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tailsoffate/tails-of-fate]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43611450/04eb12691e218c41bb0fe63095d72e8e8cfe546d.png[/img][/url]

[h2]🚀 Kickstarter Launch:[/h2]
 Exciting News! Our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/tailsoffate/tails-of-fate]Kickstarter campaign[/url] for Tails of Fate goes live early next month! This is your chance to join us in bringing this thrilling, furry-filled 2D action-adventure Metroidvania to life. 

🎁 Don’t miss out on early bird discounts and exclusive physical rewards, including an adorable plushie and a stunning figurine!

Let’s make Tails of Fate a reality together—stay tuned!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43611450/599d0eedb7c2d3dfcf17cfc6ee2b608f8645b8c4.gif[/img]

[h2]🕹️ Gameplay Update:[/h2]

[b]New Additions:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]World Map & Fast Travel:[/b] Introducing the world map for easier navigation and fast travel between key/secret locations.
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43611450/33e8f95ee5ae14d7ea60c20b5a43e4c6ad476b2c.gif][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43611450/33e8f95ee5ae14d7ea60c20b5a43e4c6ad476b2c.gif[/img][/url]
[*][b]Quest System:[/b] Added a quest system with a couple of new, engaging quests to explore and complete.
[*][b]Dialogue System:[/b] Implemented a dynamic dialogue system to add depth and interaction with NPCs.

[/list]
[b]New Areas:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Hub Area:[/b] Explore a new small hub area filled with opportunities and interactions.
[/list]
[b]Gameplay Improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Balance Changes:[/b] Made several balance adjustments to improve overall game experience.
[/list]

[h2]📅 2024 Recap:[/h2]
2024 was an incredible year for Tails of Fate! We had an amazing time showcasing our game at Gamescom and the Indie Arena Booth. Thanks to all who came out to support us and shared your enthusiasm for our project.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43611450/5b416d7e43a2df78bf014927e36b27a5331f254d.png[/img]
We couldn't have made it this far without your support. Stay tuned for more updates and get ready to join us on this incredible journey!

Cheers,  
The Tails of Fate Team 🎮✨
